visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian man dressed as a monk in a bright yellow robe and black head wrap stands before a white curtain. He holds a wooden fan and looks sternly towards the side. (2) He abruptly raises a green Garmin watch box, displaying it to the camera with a demanding facial expression. (3) A shot cut shows the same man in a different role, wearing a gray hoodie and a fake black mustache, with his hands pressed together in prayer. He has a submissive look and is wearing a green smartwatch. (4) The monk character reappears and strikes the man in the hoodie over the head with the fan in a slapstick manner. (5) The monk character continues to lecture with an aggressive facial expression while gesturing with the fan. (6) The hooded character reacts with pain and confusion, blinking rapidly while maintaining his prayer pose. (7) Another strike with the fan occurs, causing the hooded character's head to jerk to the side. (8) The monk character concludes his speech with a haughty, unyielding posture, holding the fan near his chest. (9) The final frame shows the hooded character looking upwards with an expression of utter bewilderment.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic sketch featuring a contradictory monk character who punishes his follower regardless of the follower's choice. The humor stems from the illogical anger of the authority figure and the physical slapstick hitting. It serves as a humorous way to showcase the Garmin brand and watch product.
